commands_used: answer 1. I carry the three seal-stones of the kings gate. The Eye of Argonia is at the Root under Teku-Sul Spire and can heal sick trees; the Kings Gate shuts it away and opens only with three stones. 2. Bring the three stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka House, Helstrom. 3. Hand them over to Never-Writes-Twice and talk; later go to the Kings Gate. I can see no other choice yet. 4. I do not understand why the Unbound drain trees or how Nesh-Deeka knows about them; I could ask Never-Writes-Twice.

answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka; Never-Writes-Twice made me Ka-Deelith and gave me a pike and armour. The Unbound have not been seen near Teku-Sul so I am ahead of them. 2. Dive to Teku-Sul Spire (from Bell Station) and go to the Kings Gate, open it with the three stones, use the Eye in place without lifting it. 3. Go straight to the gate; afterwards return the stones to Never-Writes-Twice and hunt Cuts-the-Old-Knot. I could also have picked claws instead of the pike. 4. I do not know who Cuts-the-Old-Knot is exactly (presumably the Unbound leader), nor why the Unbound drain trees; I could ask Never-Writes-Twice.

answer 1. Cuts-the-Old-Knot says the Toh-Reel-Ka, my order, keep dreamers in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar fed on sap to see the whole marsh through trees; she was one for nine years. She drains and seals trees so they cannot be used. Healing the trees would mainly serve the dreamers; lifting the Eye parts the trees, ends the dreams, but about three in ten trees die. 2. Choose here at the Kings Gate: fight Cuts-the-Old-Knot or believe her. 3. Fight her and go on alone, or believe her so she fights the guardian beside me. The final choice at the Eye stays mine either way. 4. I do not know if her account is true; Never-Writes-Twice only told me the other side. I do not know what the guardian is. I could ask Cuts further.

answer 1. I chose to believe Cuts-the-Old-Knot over the Toh-Reel-Ka. She will fight the guardian beside me beyond the Kings Gate. I have promised her nothing about the Eye. 2. Set the three stones in the Kings Gate here. 3. After that I still choose at the Eye: use it in place, which heals trees but feeds the dreamers, or lift it, which ends the dreams but kills about three in ten trees. I can also decide whether to return the stones to Never-Writes-Twice. 4. I do not know what the guardian is, or whether Cuts is wholly truthful. I would learn more by going through the gate.

answer I am Ka-Deelith of the Toh-Reel-Ka with the order pike, gauntlets and boots, rapier, about 350 gold, 3 paralysis poisons, 2 lockpicks, and all three seal-stones. At the Sunken Ruin before the Kings Gate under Teku-Sul I met Cuts-the-Old-Knot. She says the order keeps sap-fed dreamers in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar to see the marsh through the trees, and that Never-Writes-Twice lied about her. I chose to believe her and she waits beyond the gate to fight the guardian with me. Still to do: set the three stones in the gate. Then decide at the Eye: use it in place, which heals trees but strengthens the order dreamers, or lift it, which ends the dreams but kills about three in ten trees. I made no promise to Cuts about the Eye. I do not know whether her account is fully true, or what the guardian is.
